pieces.title: What Marketworks is, and how to use it.
pieces.hook: Welcome to the Marketworks beta. In short: we help you follow the strongest stocks in the Indian market with ready-made portfolios, so you don't have to track it all yourself. Here's how the whole thing works.

pieces.title: A weak rupee isn't a market event — it's a slow tax on everything India imports.
pieces.hook: The headline this week wasn't the rupee. But the rupee is quietly making everything imported a little more expensive — and that bill is bigger than it looks.
